name: Sadducees
overview: The Sadducees were a prominent Jewish sect during the time of John the Baptist and Jesus, often appearing alongside the Pharisees. John the Baptist rebuked them sharply for their lack of genuine repentance despite their religious heritage, warning them against relying solely on their lineage from Abraham. Jesus also cautioned His disciples to beware of the 'leaven' of both the Pharisees and Sadducees, indicating their corrupting influence. Additionally, the Sadducees are noted for challenging Jesus, such as demanding signs from heaven, reflecting their skepticism and opposition to His ministry.
